name: Do I need to move out of my home during drywall crack repairs?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to move out of my home during drywall crack repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most standard drywall crack repairs, you typically do not need to move out of your home. Contractors will usually seal off the work area to contain dust and debris, and repairs are often completed within a day or two. However, if the repair is extensive, involves significant demolition, or requires addressing serious underlying structural issues, your contractor might advise temporary relocation for safety and convenience.
acceptedAnswer.description: You typically don't need to move out for standard drywall crack repairs. For extensive repairs or structural issues, temporary relocation might be advised by your contractor.
